description: This PHP test class `PerformanceTrackerReviewerAPITest` tests the `PerformanceTrackerReviewerAPI` class within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It contains tests for retrieving all performance tracker reviewer entries and placeholders for create and delete operations, which are currently not implemented.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerReviewerAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the PerformanceTrackerReviewerAPI, extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase, testing retrieval of reviewer data and placeholder methods for create and delete API operations.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all performance tracker reviewers via the API, using data provider for input cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testGetAll method, sourcing data from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that calling create() on the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Ensures that getValidationRuleForCreate() throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that delete() on the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that getValidationRuleForDelete() throws a not implemented exception.
